lines.t: Verse 1
He sat on a bench where the old trees sway
Watching all the people just pass his way
Sun was shining but he felt the rain
Carrying a heart full of quiet pain
A stranger came and took a seat
Said, “You look like you’ve been fighting deep”
He sighed and said, “Man, I don’t know
Feels like my whole world’s letting go”
Verse 2
“She don’t hear me, I don’t understand
We’re building walls we never planned
Every word just turns to flame
Love don’t feel the same these days”
The stranger nodded, eyes so kind
Like he’d seen this a thousand times
Said, “I know a truth that can restore
What feels like it’s lost for sure”
Pre-Chorus
He said, “Sometimes pride will lead us blind
But healing starts when hearts realign”
Chorus
An unyielding heart sows discord in marriage
And stubbornness shuts the door to reconciliation
But the one who’s first to say “I’m sorry” is wise
Defusing the fire before it can rise
And the one who forgives, quick to release
Finds in their soul a beautiful peace
Yeah love can be mended, love can be strong
When grace steps in where pride was wrong
Verse 3
He looked down at his trembling hands
Like hope was something he couldn’t stand
But something broke, something turned
As those simple words began to burn
“Maybe I’ve been holding tight
To being wrong or being right
Maybe love is laying it down
Before it all comes crashing down”
Bridge
The breeze rolled through like heaven’s breath
Speaking life where there was death
And in that moment, something changed
Hope didn’t feel so far away
Chorus
An unyielding heart sows discord in marriage
And stubbornness shuts the door to reconciliation
But the one who’s first to say “I’m sorry” is wise
Defusing the fire before it can rise
And the one who forgives, quick to release
Finds in their soul a beautiful peace
Yeah love can be mended, love can be strong
When grace steps in where pride was wrong
Outro
He stood up slow, wiped his eyes
Saw the world in a different light
Turned to thank the man who stayed—
But the bench was empty… he’d slipped away
Now he walks with a softened heart
Ready to make a brand new start
‘Cause sometimes heaven meets you right where you are
On a quiet bench… beneath the stars
